source_basis.tradingview: AYK Fib Scalper public protected-script description
source_basis.source_risk_note: Source describes 0.786+ATR-buffer stop, 2R target and 1R breakeven; DELTA does not import source exits because this unit isolates entry quality under frozen 30-second execution.

causal_grammar.pivot: Strict symmetric 3-left/3-right confirmed swing high/low, visible only after right-side bar 3 completes.
causal_grammar.leg: Alternate confirmed pivot types. A low->high leg is bullish; high->low is bearish. Same-type more-extreme pivots supersede but do not form a leg.
causal_grammar.qualification: At the newly confirmed endpoint, absolute pivot-to-pivot range must be >=2.5 * ATR14 visible at endpoint confirmation.
causal_grammar.arm: One pending setup at a time. Bullish entry = high - 0.705*(high-low). Bearish entry = low + 0.705*(high-low).
causal_grammar.fill: Within next 15 completed M5 bars, first causal price interaction with projected entry arms a signal; execute at first P75 tick at/after interaction bar end.
causal_grammar.expiry: Erase unfilled setup after 15 bars or when a new qualifying impulse supersedes it.

gates.advance_rule: Advance unchanged M5 default entry only if supply and nonnegative direct net pass.
